name: Bile duct / gallbladder cancer
theme: the anatomy-split family · the actionable-alteration surprise

meta.title: Biliary tract cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Biliary tract cancers (intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, perihilar/distal extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder carcinoma), adult
meta.population: Adults with biliary tract cancer - THE ANATOMY-SPLIT FAMILY: one family, three anatomies, and the split runs all the way down - the operations differ (hepatectomy for intrahepatic; hilar resection or protocol transplant for perihilar; pancreatoduodenectomy for distal; extended cholecystectomy for gallbladder) AND the molecular profiles differ (VERIFIED map: FGFR2 fusions 7-15% and IDH1 mutations 10-20% concentrate in INTRAHEPATIC disease; HER2 amplification concentrates in gallbladder/extrahepatic; perihilar enriched for KRAS and ERBB2). THE ACTIONABLE-ALTERATION SURPRISE: this once-nihilistic family now carries one of GI oncology's densest target lists - FGFR2, IDH1, HER2, BRAF V600E, NRG1 fusions (zenocutuzumab approved 2026-05, the newest), MSI-H, NTRK - which is why up-front NGS plus HER2 IHC before cycle 1 is the board's first artifact. Epi verified: intrahepatic incidence rising for four decades (0.44 to 1.18 per 100,000, 1973-2012); gallbladder cancer's geography (Chile, North India) and gallstone link (~80% of Indian GBC) verified.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the anatomy-split family. THE FIRST-LINE ERA is verified: gemcitabine/cisplatin (ABC-02 - whose primary PMID hit the sweep's most dangerous trap: an EXACT-TITLE COLLISION with a commentary decoy, so the primary ships DOI-cited) plus durvalumab (TOPAZ-1, PMID-verified, mOS 12.8 vs 11.5 - with the late-indexing PMID-vintage trap documented) or pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-966, PMID-verified, 12.7 vs 10.9 - with a source's misdated approval resolved to 2023-10-31); either IO doublet is defensible and the spec forces neither. SECOND LINE: FOLFOX (ABC-06 verified…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: Anatomic classification (iCCA / perihilar+distal eCCA / gallbladder) as the router, with the VERIFIED molecular-distribution map (PMID-matched) as its modern second axis; AJCC staging by anatomy (secondhand); incidental-gallbladder-cancer T-stage logic on verified registry receipts (re-resection >=T1b; segments IVb/V + hepatoduodenal lymphadenectomy)
meta.response: OS for the chemo-IO first line at verified grade (TOPAZ-1 12.8 vs 11.5 months; KEYNOTE-966 12.7 vs 10.9 - both verified snippet); ORR for the targeted chapters WITH their documented denominator/assessment traps (zanidatamab 41.3% trial-cohort vs 52% label-population; ROAR-BTC 53% investigator vs ~47% IRC memory-grade; FIGHT-202's moving ORR 35.5%->37.0% date-stamped)

Newly diagnosed.name: Hepatectomy + adjuvant capecitabine (resectable intrahepatic)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the resectable-iCCA standard (NCCN secondhand; BILCAP honesty verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized adjuvant receipt at its honest ITT grade; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.patient: For bile-duct cancer inside the liver that surgery can remove: a major liver operation followed by six months of chemotherapy pills - offered with an honest note that the pill trial technically missed its primary goal but a planned analysis showed benefit, and the world adopted it.

Newly diagnosed.name: Hilar resection / protocol transplant / Whipple (resectable extrahepatic)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the extrahepatic standards (NCCN secondhand; transplant receipt verified, protocol-only)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified transplant receipt + convention; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the family's biggest operations - the center's volume is itself a variable
Newly diagnosed.patient: For duct cancers at or below the liver's hilum: the family's most demanding operations - and for select tumors at the hilum that cannot be cut out, a strict transplant program with genuinely strong long-term results.

Newly diagnosed.name: Extended cholecystectomy / re-resection (resectable gallbladder - the incidental pathway)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the incidental-GBC standard (verified registry receipts; NCCN secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: a second operation - the window and the sequence receipts are why timing is taught

Newly diagnosed.name: Gem/cis + immunotherapy (advanced - the doublet era)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the first-line standard (both trials verified; both approvals dated)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: two randomized phase 3 receipts (verified snippet numbers)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: platinum-doublet + checkpoint ledgers; obstruction management the standing companion craft
Newly diagnosed.patient: For advanced bile-duct or gallbladder cancer: chemotherapy plus immunotherapy - two large trials each proved a version of it, and either is a legitimate choice.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift

refs.label: ABC-02 (Valle, NEJM 2010;362:1273-81): cisplatin/gemcitabine vs gemcitabine - n=410, mOS 11.7 vs 8.1 months (verified snippet) - THE BACKBONE. Ships DOI-CITED (10.1056/NEJMoa0908721): the sweep's most dangerous trap was here - an EXACT-TITLE COLLISION where pubmed url-match returned PMID 20678012, almost certainly a commentary DECOY sharing the title verbatim; the NEJM editorial 20375411 verified adjacent; the memory-grade primary PMID (20375404) is NOT printed without confirmation | PMID 20375404 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

TOPAZ-1 (Oh, NEJM Evidence 2022 - PMID 38319896, pubmed-url-match - THE LATE-INDEXING TRAP documented: a 2022 paper carrying a 2024-range PMID; do not reject on vintage heuristics): durvalumab + gem/cis - mOS 12.8 vs 11.5 months, ~20% death-risk reduction (verified snippet); updated long-term OS matched (38823398); FDA 2022-09-02 (secondhand; the FDA approval-summary receipt for BOTH 1L IO approvals matched: 38856639); PRO paper 38697156 (matched) | PMID 38319896 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

KEYNOTE-966 (Lancet 2023 - PMID 37075781, pubmed-url-match): pembrolizumab + gem/cis - mOS 12.7 vs 10.9 months (verified snippet); FDA 2023-10-31 (a source's 'April 2026' MISDATING caught and resolved against FDA/ONS receipts). Either IO doublet defensible - the spec forces neither | PMID 37075781 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ABC-06 (Lancet Oncol 2021 - PMID 33798493, pubmed-url-match): FOLFOX vs active symptom control, second line - OS benefit, q2w max 12 cycles (verified snippet; specific medians memory-grade, held); the 2L reference regimen; editorial 34197747 (matched) | PMID 33798493 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE HONEST SPLIT: NIFTY (Korean, Lancet Oncol 2021 - PMID 34656226, pubmed-url-match; BICR PFS improved) with its RE-AUDITED JAMA Oncol 2023 update (36951834, matched - followed a data re-review; cite both) VERSUS NALIRICC (German AIO - PMID 38870977, matched: NO PFS or OS improvement, higher toxicity). Liposomal irinotecan + 5FU/LV is a judgment call, never a standard - the split IS the teaching | PMID 38870977 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE FGFR2 CHAPTER with its traps: pemigatinib FIGHT-202 (primary 32203698 + FINAL 38838500, both pubmed-url-matched: cohort A n=108, ORR 37.0%, mDOR 9.1, mPFS 7.0, mOS 17.5 - THE MOVING-ORR TRAP date-stamped: 35.5% in 2020 -> 37.0% final; FDA accelerated 2020-04-17); futibatinib FOENIX-CCA2 (NEJM 2023 - 36652354, matched; ORR 42% MEMORY-GRADE; FDA 2022 memory-grade) with its confirmatory FOENIX-CCA3 TERMINATED for accrual (verified 2025-02) - the accelerated pathway UNRESOLVED, loud flag; FIGHT-302 1L pemigatinib NOW FIRSTHAND and no longer secondhand (JCO 2026 - 42223137, url-matched): TERMINATED for enrollment at n=167 after a standard-of-care shift, met PFS 8.3 vs 6.8 mo (HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.39-0.87) and ORR 47% vs 15%, but NO OS BENEFIT (~24.4 vs ~25.0 mo) - 1L pemigatinib stays INVESTIGATIONAL, and this is the teaching case that a met PFS endpoint is not a label; lirafugratinib (RLY-4008) APPROVED 2026-09-23 as Lyrfigtu (Elevar, NDA 220425, 70 mg CAPSULE daily), FDA-verified ORR 46% (95% CI 36-55) and mDOR 11.8 mo (95% CI 7.5-13.0) from REFOCUS NCT04526106, single-arm, FDA efficacy population n=116 - CORRECTION THIS PASS: the 46.5% carried here was press-grade and the FDA figure is 46%, so the old number is retired. THREE TRAPS ON THIS DRUG: (1) it holds REGULAR approval, not accelerated - verified from the approval letter, which is headed 'NDA APPROVAL', never mentions subpart H, and imposes only safety/dose-optimization PMRs, making it the ONLY one of the three FGFR2 doors whose benefit is not provisional; (2) its two PMIDs SUPPORT NO EFFICACY CLAIM - 38300868 is the PNAS 2024 preclinical med-chem discovery paper and 41571046 is an Ann Oncol 2026 ctDNA resistance study in n=28, so the pivotal cohort has NO peer-reviewed publication and NO posted registry results, leaving ORR/DOR resting on FDA alone; (3) mPFS 11.3 mo circulates widely but traces ONLY to an Elevar corporate press release - not FDA, not a journal, not the registry - so it is WITHHELD here, and mOS is unreported anywhere. Full prescribing information was still unposted at 2026-09-30 (accessdata 404, DailyMed 0 results), so the warnings list is INCOMPLETE at three items (ocular toxicity, hyperphosphatemia/soft-tissue mineralization, embryo-fetal) while the approval letter also names severe stomatitis, PPES, retinal pigment epithelial detachment and nail toxicities as known serious risks - re-check the label before publishing a definitive list; REFOCUS itself is COMPLETED with results NOT posted (registry-verified 2026-09-30); tinengotinib: CHINA-ONLY approval (world-first post-FGFRi) - never a US door; FIRST-308 fully enrolled. THE PARADOX: the richest pipeline, no open US enrollment | PMID 38838500 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

refs.label: INFIGRATINIB WITHDRAWN (FDA-verified, fda.gov): accelerated approval withdrawn 2024-05-16 at sponsor request (confirmatory-trial accrual failure + commercial non-viability - not safety). Property-enforced: infigratinib on NO card - the 'three approved FGFR inhibitors' answer is a documented trap. A PubMed-only pipeline would have MISSED this (the regulatory-receipts-live-outside-PubMed lesson)

LIRAFUGRATINIB APPROVED 2026-09-23 (FDA-verified, fda.gov) as Lyrfigtu (Elevar, NDA 220425, Type 1 NME): 'previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or other rearrangement' - the approval-letter wording, which says 'fusion' where the FDA press announcement says 'gene fusion'. 70 mg CAPSULE once daily (several secondhand sources say tablet - wrong). ORR 46% (95% CI 36-55), mDOR 11.8 mo (95% CI 7.5-13.0), IRC per RECIST v1.1, REFOCUS NCT04526106 single-arm, FDA efficacy population n=116 (NOT the 490 total enrollment - do not conflate). THE HEADLINE TRAP: this is REGULAR approval, not accelerated - the letter is headed 'NDA APPROVAL', never cites 21 CFR 314 subpart H, carries no confirmatory-benefit condition, and its PMRs (5057-1 dose-optimization/toxicity, 5057-2 DDI PK) are safety not benefit-confirmation; FDA's Ongoing Cancer Accelerated Approvals page does not list it. So the NEWEST door is the only non-provisional one while pemigatinib and futibatinib remain unconverted accelerated approvals - the reverse of the usual intuition. WITHHELD BY RULE: mPFS 11.3 mo traces only to an Elevar press release (not FDA, not a journal, not the registry) and mOS is unreported anywhere. NO peer-reviewed publication of the pivotal cohort exists and REFOCUS has posted no registry results, so ORR/DOR rest on FDA alone. Prescribing information still unposted 2026-09-30 (accessdata 404, DailyMed 0 results) - warnings known incomplete at three (ocular, hyperphosphatemia/soft-tissue mineralization, embryo-fetal) while the letter also names severe stomatitis, PPES, retinal pigment epithelial detachment, nail toxicities

FIGHT-302 REPORTED - the promoted-to-firsthand upgrade this pass (was 'secondhand ASCO 2026'). Bekaii-Saab TS et al., J Clin Oncol 2026;44(23):2187-97 (PMID 42223137, url-matched) with registry results posted 2026-08-11. 1L pemigatinib vs gem-cis, phase 3 randomized 1:1 open-label, TERMINATED - registry reason verbatim: 'The study was terminated due to lack of enrollment resulting from a change in the standard of care for the first-line treatment of patients with cholangiocarcinoma. There were no safety concerns that contributed to this decision.' n=167 actual. MET its PFS endpoint (8.3 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.39-0.87) and ORR 47% vs 15%, but NO OS BENEFIT (~24.4 vs ~25.0 mo). TWO TRAPS: it tested FIRST LINE while the approved indication is previously-treated, and a met PFS endpoint is not a label - pemigatinib's CCA indication is STILL accelerated and has never converted, so 'positive phase 3' must not be read as confirmation. Exact OS CIs unverified: the PubMed abstract renders the pair as '24.425.0' with the separator lost

THE IDH1 CHAPTER, crossover-honest: ClarIDHy primary (Lancet Oncol 2020 - PMID 32416072, pubmed-url-match: n=187, 2:1, central-review PFS significantly improved) + final OS (34554208, matched - the verified phrasing: 'favorable OS benefit vs placebo DESPITE A HIGH RATE OF CROSSOVER'; the ITT non-significance/RPSFT stats MEMORY-GRADE, withheld). FDA 2021 memory-grade. Forward doors: the 1L quadruplet NCT06501625 (recruiting per 2026-05 source); adIVO maintenance NCT07260175 (status stale); the IO-combo NCT05921760 (status unknown) | PMID 32416072 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE HER2 CHAPTER - the two-label equipoise with its denominator trap: zanidatamab HERIZON-BTC-01 (Lancet Oncol 2023 - PMID 37276871, pubmed-url-match) - THE TRAP documented: cohort-1 cORR 41.3% (trial, HER2-amplified - memory-grade) vs FDA-label ORR 52%/mDOR 14.9 mo (n=62, IHC 3+) - different denominators, BOTH real, kept distinct; accelerated approval 2024-11-20 (FDA-verified) for IHC 3+ ONLY, still accelerated (confirmatory = HERIZON-BTC-302); trastuzumab deruxtecan tumor-agnostic accelerated April 2024 (IHC 3+; BTC cohort ORR 56.3% - secondhand) - a genuine second label route; MyPathway trastuzumab+pertuzumab (34339623, matched: ORR 23%, 9/39) beneath both. First-line HER2 access = the 302 trial, not off-label use | PMID 37276871 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE OTHER DOORS: BRAF V600E - ROAR-BTC (32818466, pubmed-url-match: n=43, INVESTIGATOR ORR 53% verified; IRC ~47% MEMORY-GRADE - the assessment-source trap; pooled ROAR 37059834 matched); NRG1 fusion - ZENOCUTUZUMAB approved 2026-05-08 (FDA-verified; eNRGy, n=22 CCA) - THE NEWEST BTC approval, <1% prevalence, on the panel's list; MSI-H/dMMR pembrolizumab + NTRK larotrectinib/entrectinib: MEMORY-GRADE this sweep (established but unsearched - absent from quoted numbers, not denied) | PMID 32818466 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

refs.label: BILCAP (Primrose, Lancet Oncol 2019;20:663-673): adjuvant capecitabine - THE ITT HONESTY snippet-VERIFIED: 'failed to meet its primary endpoint by intention-to-treat analysis; a preplanned sensitivity analysis highlighted a survival benefit, leading to wide adoption.' Primary PMID INFERENCE-FLAGGED (comment 30922732 matched; primary plausibly adjacent 30922733 - inference, not verification; cited by journal/DOI); long-term outcomes JCO 2022 (35316080, matched). The US adjuvant standard, taught with its asterisk | PMID 30922733 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

ASCOT/JCOG1202 (PMID 36681415, pubmed-url-match): adjuvant S-1 - 3-yr OS 77.1% vs 67.6%, HR 0.69 (0.51-0.94), p=0.008 (verified snippet); the snippet itself frames it as standard 'in Asian patients' - the ex-US framing verified, not imposed | PMID 36681415 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE VERIFIED MOLECULAR MAP (PMID 31392046, pubmed-url-match): iCCA - higher IDH1/BAP1/PBRM1 + FGFR2 fusions (FGFR2 7-15%; IDH1 10-20%); gallbladder - higher HRD + HER2 amplification/overexpression; extrahepatic/GBC - HER2-enriched; perihilar - KRAS + ERBB2 enriched. The anatomy-split family's second axis, receipt-verified (the briefing's distribution claim CONFIRMED; 'IDH1 ~13%' widened to the verified 10-20% range) | PMID 31392046 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE INCIDENTAL-GBC RECEIPTS, all matched: German Registry T1b immediate radical re-resection (21365537); German Registry T1b-T3 extended-cholecystectomy prognosis (24005717); THE T2b SEQUENCE-HARM receipt - index cholecystectomy before oncologic re-resection worsens survival (30711243); Yokohama multicenter re-resection strategy (33622924). Snippet consensus: re-resect >=T1b (T1b debated, guideline-recommended); segments IVb/V + hepatoduodenal lymphadenectomy; ~4-8-week window | PMID 30711243 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE PROTOCOL-TRANSPLANT RECEIPTS: perihilar - Darwish Murad 12-center US study (PMID 22504095, pubmed-url-match: neoadjuvant chemoradiation -> transplant, 65% five-year recurrence-free survival); Mayo single-center 92/82/82% 1/3/5-yr (secondhand); Irish Mayo-protocol experience 31972704 + neoadjuvant-CRT multicentre 37032423 (matched). iCCA - Methodist/MDA series (29548617, matched; Lancet GH 2018) and its prospective protocol NCT06140134 (status unverified). PROTOCOL-ONLY, both lanes - referral, never general option | PMID 22504095 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE LOCOREGIONAL HONESTY: MSK HAI-FUDR + gem/ox phase 2 COMPLETED (JAMA Oncol 2019 - PMID 31670750, matched receipt); HELIX-1 continuation (NCT04251715) status UNVERIFIED; Mayo Y90 + durva/treme phase 1 (NCT06058663) status unverified; NO RANDOMIZED US HAI DOOR FOR iCCA EXISTS - EA2222/PUMP is COLORECTAL-LIVER-METASTASES-ONLY (the mis-citation trap, documented against ECOG-ACRIN's own page). HAIC-style Chinese trials are not US pump practice | PMID 31670750 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

SWOG S1815 (JCO 2025, verified via full publication): gem/cis/nab-paclitaxel vs gem/cis first line - NEGATIVE (mOS 13.8 vs 12.7, HR 0.93, p=0.58); locally-advanced and gallbladder subgroup signals are HYPOTHESIS-ONLY, taught as such.
